text_rules: Use 3-5 words max mixing Hindi+English with a ₹ price or number + a SHOCK/LOSS keyword in yellow (#FFD400) against dark background; end with a question mark or alarming consequence to create irresistible curiosity gap. Avoid purely educational/technical terms (BIOWASH, YARN COUNT) — lead with the FINANCIAL PAIN or SCAM ANGLE instead.
layout: Keep all text in the center 25%-70% vertical band (safe from Instagram grid-crop and YouTube player UI); place bold 2-line stacked text dead-center with the ₹ number or GSM keyword in yellow on line 1 and the consequence/question in white on line 2, no face needed — product-context or dark/blurred warehouse background works best.
patterns: Top-performing Indian business Reels thumbnails follow a LOSS-STORY formula: a specific ₹ amount or quantity (₹40K, 500 Pcs) paired with a disaster word (Crack, Reject, Scam, Waste) creates an immediate emotional hook that stops the scroll. Hinglish question-format covers (e.g., '220 GSM लिखा 160 निकली?') massively outperform pure-Hindi or pure-English educational covers. Dark or product-shot backgrounds with high-contrast yellow+white bold text dominate over illustrated, pastel, or cream-toned designs.
ig_patterns: Highest save-rate covers promise DIAGNOSTIC VALUE — '3 Checks', '3 Things' — paired with a relatable ₹ loss scenario, making viewers bookmark for future reference before their next bulk order. Highest share-rate covers expose INDUSTRY SCAMS or SUPPLIER TRICKS (GSM fraud, yarn swaps, humidity failures) that trigger 'my retailer friend needs to see this' sharing impulse. Illustrated/pastel cream+navy covers with purely technical Hindi terms (BIOWASH, YARN COUNT, LYCRA) consistently fail on both saves and shares — the winning formula is bold yellow keyword + white consequence text on dark/real backgrounds with a financial or quality PAIN hook.
